A heavy chest to one side and a solid-looking shelf on the other pin the makeshift floor covering in place, though sections of torn fringe on every edge still wait to trip up the unwary foot.  Directly opposite the exit, a mildewed wooden sign with prominently painted lettering hangs from a nail on the wall.
title: [Tallytoe's Salvage]
19112.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: This large cabin is warm, well-lit, and quite comfortable.  A fine selection of hand-tailored clothing is displayed upon a low wooden table in the room's center, and dozens of hats and other miscellaneous accessories line the shelves along the walls.  The slight scents of pipe tobacco and tanned leather mingle together to give this cabin a pleasant aroma.  An occasional quiet, high-pitched squeal from the east mars the otherwise tranquil setting.
title: [Spitfire, Thimbel's Threadworks]
19113.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A large stack of crates, boxes and barrels blocks further progress, forcing the aisle to turn back upon itself.  From one of the larger barrels sitting to the side, a small flicker of light peeks out from cracks marring its wooden slats.
title: [Spitfire, Cargo Hold]
19114.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Plain wooden planks form the bulkheads of this room.  Several crates are piled up in the corners with any stray markings scratched or burned off hastily.  Oily smoke from a pair of lanterns provides dim lighting and more than a few shadows.  To the east and west small cramped corridors lined with boxes and bales lead away.
title: [Garthlan's Wares, Entry]
19115.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Intricate scrollwork adorns a large teakwood table placed in the center of this tiny cabin.  An unfinished shelf lines one wall at eye level to the average sized halfling.  Wood chips and shavings litter the floor, while an unused broom is propped against one wall.  A carved wooden sign is the only decoration.
title: [Blargo's Blanks]
19116.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Garishly painted in a nightmare of orange and yellow, this cluttered and claustrophobic closet of a room is filled with an amazing conglomeration of puzzles, tricks and novelties.  A dented tin tub dangles from the ceiling, a badly frayed rope the only thing keeping it from plummeting to the floor.  On one wall, a small wooden shelf hangs between two flickering oil lanterns, each gathering filmy cobwebs that have turned grey with many layers of collected dust.

description: Built into the curve of the ship, the cabin is narrow and compact. Strapped to one wall, and carefully bound in place, is a bunk laden with heavy wool blankets, while underneath is a series of six metal buckets filled with tools.

19118.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: This small cabin is furnished with a pair of woven blue and white rugs that cover the planked flooring. Tiny scraps of vellum partially cover the discolored portions of the floor next to an ink-stained white oak desk.

19119.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Water barrels, wine barrels, bales of cotton -- all sorts of cargo make up the walls of the aisle. title: [Spitfire, Cargo Hold]
19120.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The cramped cabin smells of mold and seawater, with heavy pieces of dark wooden furniture dwarfing the contents of this tiny shop.  A tall oak dresser stands nearby, with pieces of fabric peeping out of an open drawer.  Against one wall a splintered maple table stands alone, while a wooden chest and a polished brass trunk encroach on the middle of the room.  Between the furniture a warped wooden door leads out.
title: [Don't Be Snotty]
19121.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Gruff-looking sailors greet customers as they step in.  To the northwest, rapscallions pick over weapons, armor, and shields, and, to the west, scallywags admire some trinkets.  Through a barnacle-covered arch, there seems to be some sort of bar.
title: [The S. S. Saulty's Ship Shop]
19122.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Sailors belly up to the carved monir bar, bellowing salty sea ballads.  They seem a little less bloodthirsty than the bunch watching the merchandise.  Grudgingly, they move aside to let other customers pass.
title: [The S. S. Saulty's Sea Bar]
19123.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The hold space is made to feel small with its low, concave ceiling and the chaotic arrangement of items.  A tin bucket is on its side in the middle of the floor, just next to a wide, red-patterned rug that is home to an assortment of fishing poles.  Nearly blocking the hatch leading out, a short table with stunted, uneven legs seems to defy all sense of the real world by standing completely upright.
title: [Lured In]
19124.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Water barrels, wine barrels, bales of cotton -- all sorts of cargo make up the walls of the aisle. title: [Spitfire, Cargo Hold]
19126.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: In this small space, low-hanging beams athwart the ceiling meet the curved outer wall of the Spitfire's hull.  At its base, the wall is punctuated by a series of discolored brass scuppers.
title: [Spitfire, A Seaward Compartment]
19127.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The low space between the decks is here completely filled with piles of fresh-sawn lumber.  All manner of woods are here, neatly stacked and bound: mundane woods, like pale boxwood and black ebony, as well as rare magical woods, from grey hoarbeam to russet-toned ruic.
title: [A Stick in Your Eye, Entry]
19128.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Stretched between two poles is a large woven hammock, which dominates one corner of the small room.  A table is placed to one side and a chest is pushed underneath, material showing from inside the partially closed lid.  Swaying from side to side as the ship rolls with the smallest disturbance of the water, a simple lantern lights the cramped space.  Hung with a striped blanket, a narrow archway leads deeper into the quarters in one direction while a small doorway gives access in another.
title: [The Lost Fletcher, Entry]
19129.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Pieces of sailcloth hang from the criss-crossed pattern of rafters above, their striped patterns decorating the small space.  Several racks of bows are hung from the walls, a wide variety available to choose from.  Several barrels stand to the side, arrows and bolts filling their hollowed bellies.  A fine selection of archery accessories are displayed on a narrow wooden counter, its length dominating the space.  A small doorway leads back towards the entry.
title: [The Lost Fletcher, Arsenal]
19130.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Filled with boxes and crates of all shapes and sizes, this small storage room is cramped and hard to maneuver in.  Several racks of goods are displayed along the back wall, while a barrel is filled with supplies ready for use rests underneath.  Scratched from years of use, a crudely made worktable is piled with a variety of raw materials and tools.  A blanketed archway leads back towards the entry.
title: [The Lost Fletcher, Supplies]
19131.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A splintered oak table and a heavy thanot counter rest along the far wall to either side of a painted black arch. A wooden hatch leads back to the cargo hold.
title: [Glass Works, Front Room]
19132.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The gentle sounds of waves breaking on a light-colored sand beach fill the air.  A series of small dunes dot the edge of the beach, marking the perimeter.  A cracked and aged wooden signpost leans haphazardly to one side, and the wall into which a hatch is set is a magnificent mural of a wide-open ocean dotted with white clouds.  Brilliant sunlight bombards the beach here through a portal cut into the ceiling.
title: [Treasure Hunt, Seaside]
19133.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Water barrels, wine barrels, bales of cotton -- all sorts of cargo make up the walls of the aisle. title: [Spitfire, Cargo Hold]
19134.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A trio of small bronze portholes streams sunlight into the tiny cabin, illuminating the collections of scented merchandise scattered throughout the room. description: Several pink-painted tables have been carefully placed around the room, each with a matching pair of chairs pushed beneath them. description: A single porthole, crusted with salt and lime scale on the outside, allows a bit of weak sunlight to filter into this cramped space. description: One large brass oil lamp, aft, supplies light for the entire cabin.  A single ironwood counter extends from bulkhead to bulkhead, separating customers from salespeople. 19150.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

19151.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The corridor opens out into a somewhat larger space that gives you room to turn around a bit and stretch, albeit carefully. 19152.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

Several pirates bustle around a lacquered black armor rack and a sturdy shield stand set up near the bulkhead.

19153.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: This room seems to be the least cluttered area in this part of the ship.  One could even go so far as to say it was neat. Along the ceiling, a series of steel hooks holds various toolkits and sundry items, while a set of plank shelves line the wall behind a cloth-covered counter.

19154.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A few sailors browse over the goods in the room but appear to be spending more time keeping an eye on the customers. description: Sharp-eyed sailors range themselves around this corner of the room, appearing to relax but not taking their eyes off of browsing visitors -- best not try to double-cross this lot!  An important looking sign perches on an easel near a round wooden table sprinkled with a few trinkets.
title: [The S. S. Saulty's Sea Trinkets]
19161.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The room is dominated by a battered trestle table set haphazardly with an assortment of good quality but mismatched silver and tableware. Off to one side sits a water-stained wooden seachest beside a stained maple sideboard.

19162.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A whistling wind cuts through this elevated area.  Near the west wall, the sand and clay ground drops away abruptly into masterfully recreated cliffs. 19163.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Gentle hills of clay and sand form a semi-circle that overlooks a perspective on a small port set against the east wall. 19164.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The pebbly sand here runs right into the northern wall. Two giant palm trees dominate this part of the island, their fronds reaching towards the faux sky.
title: [Treasure Hunt, Skull Point]
19165.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The mountain is little more than a bare rise of gravelly sand, giving the view of the rest of the island. Interspersed amongst the conifers are a variety of woodland animals.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west
title: [Treasure Hunt, Mount Topp]
19166.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Short wooden stools are scattered fairly evenly around the cabin, making it hard to approach the glaes podium near the far wall.  Two particularly short halflings, one wearing an eyepatch and the other missing both a leg and an arm, stand guard beside the podium.  They appear to be, at once, both vigilant and sleepy.
title: [Glass Works, Auction Room]
19167.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Positioned somewhere near the center of the room, a translucent glass orb rests on a sturdy, four-legged oak stand that wobbles on the uneven floorboards.  The glass panes above are covered with filth.  An old wooden crate sits in one corner, covered in a thick layer of dust.
title: [Glass Works, The Fly Trap]
19168.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A massive glass-paneled aquarium stands against the wall of this cabin, stretching from the door of this room all the way through to meet itself on the other side of the location that it started its journey from.  The room is bare of everything else except the aquarium and a small halfling pirate who stands leaning against one of the four glass panes accessible from the inside of the room.
title: [Glass Works, The Fish Bowl]
19169.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Amid piles of unfinished lengths of wood, several workbenches nestle in a veritable sea of thin wood shavings.  Clamps, planes, presses and other tools of the bowyer's trade stand in neat array on the workbenches.  Tucked into the few remaining spaces are various hooks, displays, and racks filled with the final product of the craftsmen's exacting labor.
title: [A Stick in Your Eye, Bowyer]
19170.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The air here is dense with fine sawdust that creates an almost magical aura around the lanterns set high on the ship's beams.  Puffs of air from a tar-slicked chute in one corner keep the motes in continuous motion, although more than a little has settled on a felt-lined ironwood rack and a wide-slatted grey modwir bin.  A few beetles scurry through the sawdust on the floor, leaving tiny trails in their wake.
title: [A Stick in Your Eye, Arcana]
19171.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Various chutes, pipes, and conduits open out into this room, conveying an occasional load of rubbish.  The floor is cleverly constructed of tightly spaced wood lattice, allowing the smaller bits to fall into the fetid bilgewater below while keeping the larger detritus available for sorting.  A frayed rope ladder dangles down from some unseen vantage overhead.
title: [A Stick in Your Eye, Workshop]
19172.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: You break your long journey upward at a small landing, hardly more than a few planks wide.  Great stacks of lumber surround you, the sweet smell of the freshly sawn boards a refreshing change from the dank sewer below.  A small breeze comes from somewhere nearby, though the source seems hidden.
title: [A Stick in Your Eye, Landing]
19173.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A gleaming crystal chandelier set with dozens of tiny candles brightens this windowless room, casting dancing beams of light over a wide array of metallic and gem-crusted wares.  A long silver display table is flanked by a twisted wire tree and a skinny modwir cloak rack.  The smooth plank floors are partially covered by a fluffy pink sheepskin rug scattered with a few turquoise silk pillows.
title: [Taninky's Treasures, Trinkets]
19174.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Spotlessly clean and minimalist in decor, this room is brightened by the sleek canary silk that covers all four walls.  A plain haon wardrobe stands against the far wall, and a polished oak table rests upon a white rabbit fur rug in the middle of the room.  The northern wall is fitted with a smooth white shelf piled high with folded garments.
title: [Taninky's Treasures, Togs]
19175.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Seeing the wares for sale this room is truly difficult, as the only light source is a pair of guttering oil lamps mounted on opposite walls of the closet-like space.  A stack of crates, nailed shut, are stacked haphazardly in the corner and covered in dust and cobwebs.  An open box is on its side in the middle of the room, with some contents peeking out of the torn flaps.  A rickety old ladder is used as a makeshift clothing rack.
title: [Taninky's Treasures, Trash]
19176.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A round white table with pink painted legs is carefully placed in the center of the room.  Artfully arranged on the table are several different ingredients for making pies.  Hanging on the wall is a delicate pink sign.
title: [Pies-R-Us, Ingredient Room]
19177.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The walls in this room are white and embellished with pink-framed paintings and knick-knack lined pink shelves.  Placed by itself in the center of this room, looking awkward and out of place on a bright pink rug, is a large metal machine with lots of levers and buttons protruding from it at odd angles.
title: [Pies-R-Us, Machine Room]
19178.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Multicolored fabric bolts in variegated finishes and textures stream along the perimeter of the ship's stowage area, trailing off before a beaded sewing room curtain.  Oil lamps hanging from the bulkheads suffuse the room with a rich amber glow, spilling out across a woolen tapestry carpet laid down to minimize the creaking of the boards underfoot.  A well-kept leather textile case is opened atop some cloth-filled cabinets, adjacent to a fully covered wall of broad, fabric-stacked shelves.
title: [The Workery, Textiles]
19179.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The deck above forms a low ceiling, but the room is comfortable for those who don't have to duck.  A dozen sewing tables are set about the room, occupied by halflings busily accepting patterns from the salesclerks and sewing clothing, their small fingers moving faster than the eye can follow.
title: [The Workery, Sewing Room]
19180.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The modwir-paneled walls outfitting the spacious storage area are polished to a faint silvery gleam and house a brass-faced porthole that provides a glimpse of the water outside.  Incandescent oil lamps hanging along the bulkheads illuminate a pair of vivid cyan seascape tapestries that frame the sides of a beaded sewing room curtain and provide plenty of light to inspect a neatly labeled sewing pattern cabinet.
title: [The Workery, Patterns]
19181.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A vile conglomeration of dank water and dilute tar coats the wall of the unassuming chamber in the ship's ballast.  Though the floor is marginally dry, the pervasive dampness has soaked into and rotted heaps of old cloth and what appears to have been a collection of old cabbage. title: [Old Noralgar Road, Prairie]
6528.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Anwyn Castle is again within sight, standing resolutely in the northwest.  This vantage offers a good view of the fortress's eastern ramparts, the dark turrets rising up from the hulking walls like spikes.  The track narrows to the north, where cliffs cut off Noralgar Road's further progress.
title: [Old Noralgar Road, Prairie]
6529.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The road comes to an abrupt end at the foot of sheer cliffs which tower hundreds of feet above.  Lough Ne'halin encircles the castle's eastern face and reaches to the foot of the precipices, its dark waters lapping at a large jumble of rocks massed there.
title: [Old Noralgar Road, Cliffs]
6530.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The rough jumble of rocks almost obscures the small trail, breaking its progress every few feet with turns and stone shelves that must be traversed.  Small, red-leafed shrubs grow in pockets of soil, and moss and lichens cover the rocks.  As the way gains altitude, the view of the grey lake becomes ever more impressive.
title: [Old Noralgar Road, Cliffs]
6531.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Granite cliffs tower overhead, their faces marked with a wealth of striations and their peaks bearded with slowly drifting clouds.  A small door is cut into the stone, with seams that are joined so cleverly they are almost invisible.  To the west, the escarpment meets an imposing castle perched against the protective rock, while a glassy lake stretches from its foot into the foggy distance.
title: [Old Noralgar Road, Cliffs]
6532.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: As the old thoroughfare travels toward the castle, the prairie grass begins to thin and wither away.  The fortress is a huge, rambling edifice, thrusting up from the cold lake-water lapping at its feet.  The shores of the lake known as Lough Ne'halin stretch away to the northwest, bounded by stark cliffs, and in the distance there, a thin tower sticks up out of the gloomy fog like a skeletal finger.
title: [Noralgar Road, Castle Approach]
6533.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The cold waters of Lough Ne'halin serve as a moat, wrapping around the feet of the cliff-like curtain wall girding the dark castle called Anwyn.  The old drawbridge stands open, spanning the lake and giving access to a barbican that guards the fortress's approach.
title: [Noralgar Road, Castle Approach]
6534.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The hard packed dirt is broken here and there by small tufts of grass, pushing through the surface.  On each side of the square loom seemingly abandoned buildings, their doors absent from vandalism or decay.  A bird darts out from one of the eaves, the noise of its wings shattering the still air.
title: [Abandoned Village]
6535.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: To the south, only the front and left walls of the building remain standing, the door open to the grasses that grow in the windbreak provided.  The building to the east has suffered in the elements as well, as the roof beams have fallen, blocking the doorway.  Rising above the beams are tall grasses, protected from grazing animals by the huge wooden forms they surround.
title: [Abandoned Village]
6536.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Slate fallen from the roof blocks the slim passage between these two buildings.  The gaping door in the corner of the building to the north opens into darkness, as the roof on that structure remains intact. Despite the size of the door opening, little light appears to fall inside the building.
title: [Abandoned Village]
6537.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Shadows surround a massive stone fireplace standing next to the door.  The rock is coated with the grime and soot accumulated over years of use.  Next to it lies a massive slab of stone with deep holes drilled into it.  The room is silent except for a few chirps from birds nesting in the rafters overhead.
title: [Abandoned Village, Workshop]
6538.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The building to the west shows signs of forced entry, huge chips of stone taken from the vicinity of where the hinges would have hung.  The massive wooden doors themselves lie flat just inside the opening, with dents in the wood where they have been struck in an attempt to enter this building.
title: [Abandoned Village]
6539.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The edifice of this building is stained white, a reminder of the birds that nest in the peak of the roof, hidden under the exposed timbers.  Large windows flank the door, open to the elements.  To the left of the building lies a pile of rocks, ranging from the size of a giantman, to pebbles.
title: [Abandoned Village]
6540.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Moonlight spills across the floor, the dust motes swirling in the beams as they lance through the windows and door.  The walls on either side are compartmented, with cubbyholes the length of a man.  Much of the wood has rotted, making each platform a precarious place to put any substantial weight.  By the looks of the accumulated detritus, it appears that many smaller animals have made their homes here.  A mass writhes above, the darkness hiding all but the motion and rustling sound of bats.

description: The rough timber planks of this drawbridge must be at least two feet thick, and are obviously of great antiquity.  Here and there, the surface of the bridge is mottled with the green of mosses and the pale gold of lichens.  But the integrity of the heartwood appears to be unbreached, with not a crack or spot of rot to be seen.  Beneath it, the forbiddingly cold water of the lake ripples silently.
title: [Castle Anwyn, Drawbridge]
6555.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: This barbican provides a highly defensible access to the castle's outer ward, surrounded as it is by the lake's water and flanked by crenelated towers.  The drawbridge approach to the stone structure boasts a machicoulis as well as a huge portcullis, standing open and secured by an iron chain as big around as a young roa'ter.  On the castle side, a stone bridge that connects the barbican to the castle leads to another lake traverse -- via a stone bridge -- which grants entrance to Castle Anwyn's impressive curtain wall.
title: [Castle Anwyn, Barbican]
6556.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: This bridge between the guardhouse and the barbican is surfaced with cobblestones, their uneven surfaces slippery with the humid fog drifting across the lake.  Little protection from a fall into the grey water is offered, since the bridge's walls are barely higher than a dwarf's knee on either side.  Castellated towers flanking the guardhouse keep silent vigil over the span, warding the approach to the castle.
title: [Bridge to Castle Anwyn]
6557.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: This gatehouse is immensely solid, thirty feet square at least, with walls a foot thick.  Its inner and outer doors are each framed by a twelve-foot arch.  Overhead, the two-story structure is furnished with small slits of windows and a catwalk shielded with slotted walls for archers to use as cover.
title: [Castle Anwyn Gatehouse]
6558.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A gateway leading into the castle proper is close at hand, to the northwest.  From this vantage point, the castle's mighty towers and battlements seem impregnable.  The structure's beautiful ornamentation is evident here, from the richly carved arches with their scrollwork and fanciful friezes, to the hulking gargoyles perched on the ramparts of the flanking towers.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southwest, west, northwest
title: [Anwyn Castle Yard]
6559.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: This near-dilapidated building was apparently once used to store supplies and tools.  Broken barrels and rusty pieces of metal pepper the floor, making it difficult to walk through the place without tripping.  Squeaks and scratching sounds join the cooing of doves in the rafters, producing a soft harmony.
title: [Anwyn Castle, Storage Shed]
6560.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The yard seems almost too quiet, even though the frigid climate would naturally discourage any serenade by locust or lark.  An old building sits to the east, the architecture suggesting that it's an old chapel.  The entrance stands doorless and dark, giving it a melancholy appearance.

A few crows can be seen flying in the distance, but they're too far away to hear.  An old building sits to the east, the architecture suggesting that it's an old chapel.  The entrance stands doorless and dark, giving it a melancholy appearance.
title: [Anwyn Castle Yard]
6561.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: By all external appearances, one would have expected the serene atmosphere born of years of reverie and worship within the castle's chapel.  But this is no place of quiet introspection.  Bones lie scattered about haphazardly.  The air is fetid and almost unbreathable.  Small burial urns sit in no discernible order among the litter of bones, making navigation through the structure an exercise in caution.  Set into niches in the walls are piles of skulls, their blank stares a sinister accusation.
title: [Anwyn Castle Chapel]
6562.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The castle yard is bordered here by a quaint, old chapel on the east and the flanking tower of the inner castle wall on the west.  The tower looks to be three stories in height at least, and is topped by a crow-stepped gable.  To the north, the castle yard stops at the foot of a sizable wall.
title: [Anwyn Castle Yard]
6563.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The castle yard ends here, at a wall topped by crenellations that extends between the wall surrounding the inner ward and the exterior curtain wall.  A corridor with a fine, carved doorcase passes through the barrier, revealing its width to be more than ten spans.  The remains of an iron gate lie on the ground a short distance away.
title: [Anwyn Castle Yard]
6564.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A sprawling bramble of red-berried nettle bushes has spread itself over much of the old kitchen garden.  A few resolute herbs still hold their own -- mint, chervil and a ragged patch of lavender next to the kitchen door.  A low wall divides the garden from a bower beyond, where fruit trees survive.  The wall is richly carved, its vine scrolls inset with hollow-eyed masks, a popular motif during the castle's heyday.  An arched corridor offers passage through the towering wall enclosing this inviting area.
title: [Kitchen Garden]
6565.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The branches of ancient fruit trees create an interwoven shelter that gives this part of the garden an intimate ambiance.  A carved stone bench sits before the cliff wall at the back, extending its timeless invitation.  Against the east wall, a stone fish with flared gills and arched tail spits a stream of water into a stone-edged pool choked with green algae.
title: [Castle Bower]
6566.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: An overwhelming stink is the most noticeable feature of this chamber.  It was obviously the kitchen for the old fortification.  There's a massive stone slab in its center that offers a generous work surface and an impressive hearth on the far wall, now cold and empty.  A litter of pot shards and old implements pepper the floor, looking as if they were thrown about in a fury.  However, there is nothing that suggests what is causing the terrible stench.
title: [Castle Kitchen]
6567.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Though it hardly seems possible, the odor permeating the adjoining room is even worse here.  The cause is now apparent.  Carcasses are strewn around the room in various stages of putrefaction.  Something has obviously been using this as a cache for prey.  The shelves that once held the castle's provisions lie in a pile on one side of the larder and could possibly conceal something large enough -- or mean enough -- to cause this gory slaughter.
title: [Castle Larder]
6568.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: This long gallery connects the kitchen apartments and buttery with the Great Hall via an impressive staircase at the hall's north end.  Another hall intersects this one, leading west to other chambers and the building's main entrance.
paths: Obvious exits: east, south, west, up
title: [Castle Hall]
6569.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: This cathedral-sized room, the heart of the castle, extends up at least three-stories tall.  Two rows of stone piers march down its length, each with an elaborately carved capital.  The huge beams supporting the ceiling rest on the tops of the piers.  Doors are visible on the hall's southern expanse, but are curiously walled up with stone.  On the room's western wall, an impressive flight of stairs leads to other rooms in that wing.  At the opposite end, discrete stairs lead into the flanking tower.

description: This circular chamber is littered with the broken bones of its former furnishings.  No big surprise there.  One thing is distinctive though -- the stench here could knock an orc on its back.  That and the cold.  Every breath exhaled here frosts the air into a white fog.  No wind is stealing in to account for it, a fierce, dead cold that permeates the warmest garment.  A staircase winds up to the floor above.
title: [Anwyn Castle, East Tower]
6571.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Cold inhabits the chamber as if it were bred here.  Across the floor, debris and dust mark uninhabited time as well as a clock, sifting into the room's corners in gentle drifts.  The odor of decay hangs over the emptiness with its secretive nuances, speaking a subtle language universal to all lands.
title: [Tower Chamber]
6572.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The turret is dark and empty -- at first glance.  Then one after another, and then another winged shape swoops past your line of vision.  A look at the ceiling reveals the whole of it is covered by a vast complex of hornet nests.  Their papery convolutions curve around the roof's beams like a blanket, folding out here and there into incredible blossoms of living chambers.  Busy winged workers labor across the surface of the monstrous construction.  The staircase leading down looks exceedingly inviting.
title: [Turret]
6573.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: This paneled passage connects the Great Hall to the old keep.  A row of tall, mullioned windows -- each with a window embrasure forming a 'sitting window' -- casts irregularly shaped reflections onto the broad beams of the floor.  They shift and fade in synchrony with the drifting fog outside.
title: [Anwyn Castle, Hall]
6574.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A strange, flickering blue aurora illuminates this room.  It has no direct source, but seems to be brightest around a monstrous bone chair, the color of old teeth.  The thing is as big as a throne and its surface is polished to a soft gleam.  Facing the chair is a grisly row of pikes, each one bearing a shriveled, mummified head.
title: [Audience Chamber]
6575.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The cylindrical keep looks as if it's much older than the other parts of the castle, which follows a more modern, rectangular design.  The keep's ground floor stands two-stories tall.  Its old 'murder-holes' -- through which rocks or scalding oil were once thrown down on unwelcome guests -- are now filled in.  Halls lead off to the east and to the south, and a handsomely carved, arched door leads outside.
paths: Obvious exits: east, south, up, down
title: [Castle Anwyn Keep]
6576.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The second level of the ancient keep is starkly bare.  The floor is uneven, its stone flagging broken and cracked.  At intervals along the curved walls, arrow slits are placed, granting defense of the tiered wall-walk below.  Circular windows are located high on the walls, shedding a diffused light that leaves this chamber in gloom.  The staircase leading to upper stories is completely demolished, prohibiting further ascent.

description: The trail up the mountain ends here at the base of a sheer, 50-foot cliff face.  In front of this is a series of four stone pillars that seems to be some sort of unusual staircase.  There are also some strange markings on the mountain wall.
title: [Melgorehn's Reach, Staircase]
18178.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: You are on a narrow ledge heading west.  The east side stops at a cliff which drops about 50 feet before the trail continues west again.
title: [Melgorehn's Reach, Cliff Top]
18179.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The mountain trail ends here, opening into a wide area that provides a good place to rest.  Progress to the west ends with an exposure of several thousand feet.  You notice a wooden beam trellis which runs from this point up the side of the mountain to quite a distance above you.  On one side, a freshwater mountain stream tumbles out of an opening into a pool.

steps.await: riding on the trellis

title: [Melgorehn's Reach, Stream]
18180.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: This is an open-air, wooden box which is suspended on a beam trellis that is precariously attached to the side of the mountain.  There are plenty of openings which afford a great view, but the cab itself is covered (probably to guard against falling rocks).

steps.await: ledge comes into view and the cab grinds to a clunky halt

title: [Melgorehn's Reach, Lift]
18181.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: You are on a small shelf on the face of the mountain, very near its summit. The air is terribly misty and above you lurks the bottom of a cloud, looking strangely unnatural this near.  The view of the lands below is spectacular and frightening at the same time.  The side of the mountain from this point up is completely hidden behind an opaque wall of fog descending in plumes from the cloud above.
title: [Melgorehn's Reach, Lift Apex]
18182.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: You are in a dense fog bank and can see absolutely nothing.  You  realize that you can probably back out of here easily enough.
title: [Melgorehn's Reach, Lost in the Fog]
18183.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: You emerge onto a stone landing which looks like an island in a sea of cloud.  Somehow it is suddenly night, and the sky above is sparkling with thousands of tiny stars.  The Great Moon Liabo hangs silently in the sky, its surface shrouded by the clouds of its atmosphere.  A tiny black point against this backdrop, Tilaok, can be seen in its orbit around Liabo.  A large opening leads into the mountain at this height.
title: [Melgorehn's Reach, The Summit]
18184.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: You are in a vast, domed enclosure cut from the native rock of the mountain.  The floor is perfectly smooth but the vaulted ceiling is chiseled in an array of gothic designs.  In the center of the room sits a single onyx altar.
title: [Melgorehn's Reach, Moon Chamber]
18185.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: You are in a natural cave of the mountain.  The walls are coated with a glowing fungus providing significant lighting.  Bubbling in one corner is a small pool fed by a hot spring.  The water quickly wanders across the chamber floor in a shallow stream and then vanishes into an opening on the west wall.

title: [Melgorehn's Reach, Hot Spring]

title: [Melgorehn's Reach, Water Tunnel Racecourse]
18187.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Thick forest, interspersed with several varieties of plants and vines, encircles a large meadow.  Wildflowers add a kaleidoscope of color to the lush, green grass on either side of a cedar chip path.  Sunlight glints softly off Lake Eonak through the flora around a modest home on the far side of the meadow.  Melgorehn's Reach rises sharply into the blue sky above the home, the peak wreathed in clouds.
24501.location: Melgorehn's Retreat, outside the frontier town of Wehnimer's Landing
title: [Melgorehn's Retreat, Meadow]

24501.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Rectangular panels of polished witchwood, set with several veil iron sconces, enclose three sides of the room, while the fourth is made entirely of glass.  An enormous window, with its wide bench, provides an unobstructed view of the majestic greens of Melgorehn's Reach and the multichromatic Lake Eonak.  Dark walnut flooring is softened by a thick silk rug, accompanied by several dark leather armchairs.  In a far corner, a set of straight ko'nag stairs lead downward, and through an open doorway a few bar stools against a countertop are visible.
24502.location: Melgorehn's Retreat, outside the frontier town of Wehnimer's Landing
title: [Melgorehn's Retreat, Entryway]

assignment.title: [Melgorehn's Retreat, Entryway]
assignment.location: Melgorehn's Retreat, outside the frontier town of Wehnimer's Landing

24502.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Light floods into the airy space through a wall of glass, through which can be seen the large waterfall that feeds Lake Eonak.  In the center of the room is a long, polished white marble counter, inset with a deep double-sided sink.  High above, globes are inset in the ceiling, and a series of leather padded bar stools are lined up against the counter.  Gleaming copper pots and pans hang along the back wall above an elegant mithril stove, and an open doorway leads back to the entry.  The entire western wall is also glass, complete with a floor-to-ceiling sliding glass door leading onto the deck.
24503.location: Melgorehn's Retreat, outside the frontier town of Wehnimer's Landing
title: [Melgorehn's Retreat, Kitchen]

assignment.title: [Melgorehn's Retreat, Kitchen]
assignment.location: Melgorehn's Retreat, outside the frontier town of Wehnimer's Landing

24503.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Lacquered dark walnut flooring stretches out from the kitchen and across the neatly manicured grass of the hilltop.  The large deck is built to incorporate a narrow brook that runs down the hill to the beach and blends with the sparkling surf of Lake Eonak in the distance.  Thick, dark forests ring the lake, framing its pristine beauty against the backdrop of the Reach's majestic peak.  Several low teak chairs with elongated seats sit snug against the house.  A sliding glass door leads into the kitchen, while a narrow set of stone steps leads down the hill to the beach.
24504.location: Melgorehn's Retreat, outside the frontier town of Wehnimer's Landing
title: [Melgorehn's Retreat, Deck]

assignment.title: [Melgorehn's Retreat, Deck]
assignment.location: Melgorehn's Retreat, outside the frontier town of Wehnimer's Landing

24504.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Smooth, pristine white sand gives way to a rippled, slightly darker counterpart as it stretches toward the water's edge.  The gentle lapping of Lake Eonak, along with the soft sounds of local wildlife, enhance the calming surroundings.  Brilliant sunlight glints off several glass windows of the house bordering the northern edge of the private beach.  A narrow set of stone steps hugs the hillside and leads to a deck.  Positioned a safe distance from the lake is a round firepit surrounded by blackened sand, and closeby is a cushioned loveseat suspended from weathered wooden beams by thick chains.
24505.location: Melgorehn's Retreat, outside the frontier town of Wehnimer's Landing
title: [Melgorehn's Retreat, Beach]

24505.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Piles of sand lean against the base of the southern and western glass walls, which give a breathtaking view of Lake Eonak's sunlit surface.  The dark witchwood of the eastern wall is bisected diagonally by a set of straight ko'nag stairs.  A low, rectangular witchwood chest with square iron handles sits at the foot of a king-sized bed with a low, flat headboard, and is flanked by a nightstand that rests against the northern wall.  Joining the northern and eastern walls is a fireplace cut from ebon-veined brown marble.  A braided silk rug in muted tones stretches beneath a plush loveseat, positioned between the bed and a glass door that leads to a private beach.
24506.location: Melgorehn's Retreat, outside the frontier town of Wehnimer's Landing

description: A small platform with an opening cut in the center has been built on this hefty tree branch.  A twisted rope ladder leads down the opening, back to the meadow.  High above is a ragged hole in the tree with a gnarled rope hanging down.
title: [Oak Tree, Large Branch]
24677.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The gnarled rope has been knotted around a thick iron spike sticking out of a hole in the tree.  Little rays of moonlight that have managed to sneak past the thick green leaves that cover every branch spray down upon the tree, providing illumination to the hole.
title: [Oak Tree, Dark Hole]
24678.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Though the moonlight provides illumination at the opening of this hole, as you climb up some wooden pegs visibility diminishes until it is completely dark.
title: [Oak Tree, Dark Hole]
24679.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: It is pitch black inside the tree now, and the only way to continue moving is to feel around for the next peg to grab on to.  Climbing up the tree this way is a daunting task, as several of the pegs slip under your hands and feet.
title: [Oak Tree, Dark Hole]
24680.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: From above, a rustling sound can be heard, then nothing.  A split second later, a rush of leaves and debris come flying down the hole.
title: [Oak Tree, Dark Hole]
24681.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Up above, there is a tiny speck of light.  It is hardly visible and only the size of a pinpoint.  There are fewer wooden pegs now, making it more difficult to continue climbing.
title: [Oak Tree, Dark Hole]
24682.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: More light can be seen inside the tree now, which makes climbing a little easier.  Above is another knotted rope, though it is still too far up to reach.
title: [Oak Tree, Dark Hole]
24683.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Dangling from a perch constructed at the tree opening above your head is a thick knotted rope.  Since the wooden pegs inside the tree have all but disappeared, this appears to be the only way to continue upwards.
title: [Oak Tree, Dark Hole]
24684.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: This well-constructed perch has been situated half inside the tree and half outside.  An ornate carved railing surrounds the edge in a half-moon shape, providing protection from falling.  From this height, the ground is not visible at all.  All you can see is green leaves and branches to all sides.  Off to one side of the perch is a sturdy oak ladder leading up to another platform.
title: [Oak Tree, Wooden Perch]
24685.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Built around the entire trunk of the tree, this platform is massive in size.  A wooden railing carved with an intricate knotwork design surrounds the entire platform.  A vibrant bluebird flies by, landing in a nest filled with babies begging for food.  Up above, the cloud-filled sky is finally starting to become visible.
title: [Oak Tree, Wooden Platform]
24686.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Atop this gigantic tree, an oak platform has been constructed.  A colorful array of flower petals is scattered over the floor, occasionally whirling about the air whenever a gust of wind rushes through the tree top.  Spread about the platform are several benches, providing ideal locations for contemplation and reflection.  Near each bench is a handcrafted wicker basket filled to the brim with petals.
title: [Oak Tree, Top of the Tree]
24687.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: An iron anvil rests in the center of the small cavernous forge, surrounded by candles that keep the area dimly lit.  Tools of the trade lie scattered across the ground, covered in silt and mica.
title: [Memorial Cavern, Forge]
29564.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Dense forest abruptly cuts off the trail leading up the mountainside, but a steep path can still be traversed through the lush greenery.  Small breaks in the canopy overhead allow sunlight to pour onto the forest floor.  The scent of wildflowers lingers in the air.
title: [Mountain Forest, Steep Path]
29565.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Mossy vegetation covers everything in sight, from the trees to the forest floor.  Fallen leaves are strewn along the path, which leads eastward through a break in the mountain.  Rays of sunlight shine upon a lichen-covered boulder, highlighting odd markings in the stone.
title: [Mountain Forest, Secluded Path]
29566.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A cherry tree stands guard over a small, shallow pond overlooking Halcyon Hills.  Forest creatures gather around the tranquil pond, some darting in and out of the area.  A leaf-covered wooden cabin has an open doorway, inviting adventurers inside.
title: [Mountain Forest, Pond]
29567.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Pale mistwood paneling encloses the room, with a thin wash of silver lending a faint sheen.  A detailed circle of runes dominates the center of the floor, worked in pearlescent white tile amongst the greater pattern of azure waveform shapes.  Tightly rolled sheaves of paper peek out from small niches in the numerous scroll racks that line the walls.
title: [A Secluded Corner]
30548.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Thick thorn bushes choke the few young oaks brave enough to root here.  Long trailing vines drop pliant nooses from above and curl about your feet like vipers.  There is no path to speak of and the only way through seems to be to find the shrub with the fewest thorns and put a shoulder into it.
title: [Lower Dragonsclaw, Briar Patch]
6259.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Wooden carving knives slice away the flesh of all intruders to this horrible maze, leaving rivulets of blood and sweat to trickle down the brow of any so foolhardy as to enter here on two legs.  Twist or turn, but there is no escape from the dagger-spine pressed painfully into the soft flesh of the abdomen or the clump of stinging nettles thrust suddenly into the face.  At times the only way forward is by scrabbling on hands and knees.
title: [Lower Dragonsclaw, Briar Patch]
6260.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Underbrush and stunted oaks twist together in a death grip as the ground begins to slope downward.  Some of the nearby briars have stems so thick that, if not for their hateful thorns, you could almost mistake them for saplings.  The oaks, in turn, are bent double by masses of clinging vines.  The whole effect is of a nasty little miniature Dragonsclaw.
title: [Lower Dragonsclaw, Briar Patch]
6261.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A gnarled hedgerow of brambles marches north and south, blocking any further progress down the westward slope.  The smell of homemade cooking wafts over the stubby barrier ... or maybe something died over there.  A sturdy adventurer might be able to squeeze under the hedge without too much loss of blood.  On the other hand, a naked march back through the briars would probably be more fun.
title: [Lower Dragonsclaw, Brambles]
6262.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A ramshackle collection of shanties and lean-to sheds huddles amid a yellowish river of mist in the small, dark vale below.  The pitiful little huts crowd together in clumps, each seemingly hoping not to stand out enough to be noticed.  If the size of the dwellings left any doubt, their bedraggled state leaves none:  Only kobolds could have made such squalor in the midst of a pristine forest.
title: [Kobold Village, Hedgerow]
6263.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The village commons is a grassy swath cut into the terraced strip of land east of the village proper.  The green is set down into the rich earth just enough to keep a lethargic rolton from scrambling out on a hot day.  An unwholesome mist pools in the sunken grassy area, and the moist earth gives way to a quagmire at one end.
paths: Obvious paths: north, southwest, west, up
title: [Kobold Village, Commons]
6264.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The ground slopes downward and the thin yellow mist that clings about the vale hangs heaviest to the west.  Northward a wooded promontory overlooks the vale.  The great splendid oaks of the Dragonsclaw lean out over the precipice as though peering in disapproval at the shabby squatters below.  Some of the huts here have been built against the face of the promontory: an architectural style favored by lazy builders and maggot-hunters.
title: [Kobold Village]
6265.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The owner of this little home was either too poor or too lazy to build a roof.  Fortunately, the north wall is a scavenged piece of drawbridge that lists inward enough to huddle under during a storm.  For a door, someone has nailed up a smelly shirt that reminds you of its presence periodically as it flaps in the breeze.
title: [Kobold Village, Shanty]
6266.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A steep earthen cliff rises above you, roots dangling over the edge far above.  Several large piles of dirt lie nearby, and a broken wheelbarrow is partially buried by one.
title: [Kobold Village, Promontory]
6267.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A fetid pond of murky green slime swirls lazily around a gurgling spring at the lowest point of the vale.  A circle of tumbled stones nearby suggests that this was once the site of a well, and a few scattered buckets and washboards hint that the kobolds might actually use the brackish filth here as a water supply.  It's not a pleasant thought.
title: [Kobold Village]
6268.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The huts at this far end of the little valley are in slightly better shape and somewhat larger than elsewhere in the village.  The slothful kobolds must prize the extra hour of morning shade the rubbish mound to the east provides, or maybe they just like the smell.  One hut stands out from the others for its size and relatively sturdy construction.  The architect was surely the only one of his brethren ever to have heard of right angles.
title: [Kobold Village]
6269.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A great mound of rubbish and filth rises up here west of the commons.  Trash from every inn and tavern in Elanthia must have been dragged here to make it.  High above the surrounding slovenly huts rests an even more slovenly sight: a decrepit fishing boat lies keel-up amid the filth.  Gaping holes dot the rotting hull, only a few stopped with rickety shields and other scraps of wood serving as doorways and shutters.  The fishermen are gone, but the smell of fish lingers on.
title: [Kobold Village, Royal Mound]
6270.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Thick scented smoke chokes the air, fed from a banked fire of aromatic green branches in the center of the hut.  The walls of the hut are lined with piles of moth-eaten blankets and personal effects, suggesting that quite a few kobolds live here.  The remainder of the hut is crowded with jars of unguents, crooked staves, feathered bags, and every other form of talisman or source of evocative magic imaginable.
title: [Kobold Village, Shaman's Hut]
6271.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Some mad decorator transformed the belly of this beached fishing boat into a royal audience chamber fit only for a kobold king.  Rags and tattered clothing serve as tapestries and a carpet of red woolen undergarments, stitched end-to-end, leads up to a rickety barstool painted gold.  To the south gapes the rotting, fish-scented maw of the hold.  The crushed and inverted remains of the crew's quarters are to the north.
title: [Kobold Village, Royal Lodge]
6272.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The fishermen's bunks hang empty from the ceiling, their undersides now serving as shelves for the royal larder.  Piles of rotting fruits and meats line the jury-rigged storage areas and spill over onto the floor.  The menu boasts mainly garbage scraps and the place smells more like a compost heap than anything else.
title: [Kobold Village, King's Pantry]
6273.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Clearly His Majesty spends a great deal of time here when he isn't hiding from adventurers.  The decor is certainly the best that generations of kobold artists have produced, the centerpiece consisting of a dented helm balanced on a stick so that it rattles a bit if you tap it.  There are other equally fine treasures here, no doubt taken as spoils from the king's many victories and each almost as marvelous as the last.
title: [Kobold Village, King's Loo]
6274.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A little circle of huts have collapsed inward on themselves, leaning together for support like a group of their owners in a drunken stupor.  Around them, a twisted octopus of metal extends its tentacles.  The strange conglomeration of metal debris at first appears to be some hellish sculpture, but closer inspection, by sight and smell, suggests it is an animal cage.
title: [Kobold Village]
6275.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: While the hutch is massive for an animal cage, it's still pretty cramped to be strolling around in.  Here and there, the metal framework sags inward and patches fill most of the holes.  Picking a path through the warren of detritus is a job calling for the skill of a Ranger Lord, the fortitude of a besotted Dwarf, and the sensibilities of a guttersnipe.
title: [Kobold Village, Squirrel Hutch]
6276.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The dirt floor slopes sharply downward and less light filters in through the arch of wire mesh above.  This westernmost tentacle of the hutch, by design or mishap, seems to be burrowing its way into the soft soil.  Muffled by earthen walls, the everpresent scrabbling recedes a bit, but from the dimness ahead comes an odd new sound...softer and somehow more unsettling.
title: [Kobold Village, Squirrel Hutch]
6277.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The chamber is cloaked in mist, hot with the breath of hundreds of small, unwholesome lungs.  A single ghostly shaft of moonlight cuts downward, illuminating an awful panorama:  The roof of the hutch sags over a twenty foot earthen bowl, alive with the tiny bodies of infant rodents.  Sticks, fur, and scraps of refuse fill the bowl with a horrifying nest for the little beasts. Rabid from birth, their passionate cries pierce the shadows like shattering glass.

Sticks, fur, and scraps of refuse fill the bowl with a horrifying nest for the little beasts.  Rabid from birth, their passionate cries pierce the shadows like shattering glass.
title: [Kobold Village, Squirrel Pit]
6278.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Jagged fingers of metal point from the walls and roof at a thousand angles like a mob of kobolds asked to give directions.  The ground is awash with rodent urine and there are more squirrel pellets piled across the sodden ground than gems in an archmage's coffers.  If you lived here, you'd have a bad attitude too.
title: [Kobold Village, Squirrel Hutch]
6279.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Gnawed bones and other more obscene carrion weave a grisly carpet here, a tapestry depicting carnage more vivid than the most gifted and demented of mortal artists might dare.  You struggle to hold down your latest meal as you note a familiar looking skull nearby.  What fate could be worse than to spend eternity between the razor sharp teeth of diseased rodents?
title: [Kobold Village, Squirrel Hutch]
6280.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Darkness shrouds this tentacle of the hutch formed from iron shields fused into a great mass.  Dozens of little blood-shot eyes stare malignantly at you from the shadows, and the air is thick with the stench of disease and four-legged reproach.  Overcome with horror, your mind slips unbidden into thoughts of the chaotic passions and horrible terror that drive these villainous abominations.
title: [Kobold Village, Squirrel Hutch]
6281.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: This part of the village is not only shabby, it's boring.  Absolutely nothing distinguishes the meritless huts, one from another.  The kobolds who live here must shuffle off sadly into the forest each day with little hope of anything interesting in their pathetic lives... unless they are fortunate enough to find an end to their miserable existences at the swordpoint of some Wehnimerian whelp.
title: [Kobold Village]
6282.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The walls of this tiny hut are little more than some crooked branches tied together with twine.  Why, the builder didn't even bother to pull off the wilted leaves before bundling up the branches into thatch.  A strong breeze might collapse the whole place, not that anyone would be likely to notice.  A forlorn and threadbare cot is the only furnishing.
title: [Kobold Village, Hovel]
6283.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: What appears to be a huge mound of dirt from outside, actually slopes to a hole in the center, as though a rabid giant rodent had tunneled there, throwing dirt in all directions.  The hole is protected from the shifting earthy dunes by a sheath of rotting boards.  A confused mass of knotted ropes and pulleys dangles down into the darkness.
title: [Kobold Village, Crater]
6284.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A large bucket, half filled with dirt, sways precariously at the end of a set of heavy ropes.  Down below, the shaft stretches away into endless darkness, while moonlight glimmers above. The bucket swings back and forth, striking first one side of the shaft and then the other, sending showers of dust into the shadowy depths.  There's a dark opening in one wall, and with good timing you might climb down the side of the bucket and into the opening.

The bucket swings back and forth, striking first one side of the shaft and then the other, sending showers of dust into the shadowy depths. title: [Dirt Mines, A Really Big Bucket]
6285.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A long dark tunnel opens onto the mine's main vertical shaft.  A huge bucket swings lazily in the void, striking the opening every so often.  A musty breeze blows out from the tunnel, carrying the frighteningly seductive odor of warm loam.
title: [Dirt Mines, Dark Opening]
6286.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The first thing you notice about this tunnel is that it is dark.  It's also the last thing you notice, as it is too dark to see much else.  To the south is the faint glimmer of...well...less darkness.  To the north you think you can make out a bend in the tunnel.  Actually it's just your over-active imagination, since it's too dark to really see the bend.
title: [Dirt Mines, Dark Tunnel]

description: An open gate between two houses leads into the settlement.  The houses are made of sturdy rock walls and have thick, green-washed shutters.  A lone reiver guard attentively patrols the area.

description: The meandering pathway runs up to a steep cliff thrice the height of man.  Loose rocks edging the cliff blur in the grey of dusky shadows.  A small crack can be discerned in the darkness.
title: [Luinne Bheinn, Outer Watch]

description: The trail snakes around a cracked boulder.  Apt, since a small family of black adders seem to have made their home in this area.
title: [Luinne Bheinn, Outer Watch]
8094.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A sturdy smithy stands to the north, acrid smoke wafting from its chimney.  The door leading into the smithy is split, the upper part usually open to let heat inside escape.  A few farm tools, damaged and speckled with rust, lean against the smithy.  A large, but simple, house stands to the south.
title: [Luinne Bheinn, Settlement]
8095.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Several small houses occupy this junction, making this area seem a bit more busy than others.  One of the houses has an open-walled shed built against its side. title: [Luinne Bheinn, Settlement]
8096.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A large building dominates the rest.  Though squat like most of the other buildings, the Great Hall is easily three times the size of any other. title: [Luinne Bheinn, Settlement]
8097.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Small, thatch-roofed houses stand on both sides of the pathway.  Their sturdy, grey rock walls brightened somewhat by green-washed shutters and doors.  An old broom leans next to one door.
title: [Luinne Bheinn, Settlement]
8098.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: To the west stands a cozy-looking tavern.  The rocks used to build it are obviously taken from an older portion of the ruined peel tower.  A colorful sign dangles back and forth above the red-painted door of the tavern.
title: [Luinne Bheinn, Settlement]
8099.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A crystal clear stream runs next to the path.  Thorny, purple thistle covers the lower part of the steep banks.
title: [Luinne Bheinn, Outer Watch]
8100.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A huge boulder forces the trail to detour around it.  In the shadows under the boulder glint tiny eyes.  Once in awhile a high-pitched squeak can be heard from the dark shadows.
title: [Luinne Bheinn, Outer Watch]
8101.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Tufts of coarse grass poke up from soil-filled dips in the granite terrain.  A few mountain roltons look up from feeding briefly, then, almost with disdain, go back to it.
title: [Luinne Bheinn, Outer Watch]

description: The worn granite trail continues to circle around the settlement.  At times as you make your way forth, you spot reivers on guard duty, their proud bearing ever vigilant as they watch for krolvin attackers.
title: [Luinne Bheinn, Outer Watch]

description: A bit north of the trail lies a patch of arable land.  Poorly growing turnips and potatos show off their stunted greenery. A pathetic-looking scarecrow fails miserably at its task, a black bird resting contentedly on one of its shoulders.
title: [Luinne Bheinn, Outer Watch]

description: The mountainous path and its wavy granite surroundings are contrasted by the drab grain fields that lie to the north.  A few nocturnal birds circle the fields occasionally, perhaps eyeing either the grains or any small rodents that might be running around.

description: The monotony of the mountainous terrain is broken up by some small buildings in the distance.  An unusual smell catches your attention at times, leaving you with a nagging feeling that this is not a place to linger overlong.
title: [Luinne Bheinn, Outer Watch]

description: Thin, crusty moss covers almost everything, except the crests of the wavy mountain.  An algae-filled puddle of water struggles to survive in the rough, windy terrain.
title: [Luinne Bheinn, Outer Watch]

description: A crooked crabapple tree stands forlornly near the trail.  Despite the sickly, lichen-covered trunk and the twisted or broken branches, a few bright red apples sway boldly in the wind.

description: The smell easily gives away what the old, wooden structure to the south is. title: [Luinne Bheinn, Settlement]

description: Fields of stunted grain swirl around in the wind.  The dull-yellow rye and wheat reign over most of the barely arable land, oat stalks occupying the remainder.  On the far side of the rye stands a rather large compost heap with a pitchfork stuck into it.
title: [Luinne Bheinn, Settlement]
8110.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: To the west and south lie some pitiful-looking fields.  The potato and turnip plants look scrawny and unhealthy.  It is obvious that much back-breaking labor is needed to make anything grow here at all.  A beat-up, old plough stands next to the turnip field.
title: [Luinne Bheinn, Settlement]

description: Houses made of mortared rocks flank the pathway.  Thatched roofs extend further from the walls than seem normal. title: [Luinne Bheinn, Settlement]

description: The plateau opens up a bit to the north, as the cliff to the east slowly descends to the level of the pathway.  The settlement can barely be seen in the distance.
title: [Luinne Bheinn, Outer Watch]

description: The guard house is a scene of dusty simplicity.  Towards one wall stands a large, well-used table with two opposing chairs.  A few spears and a broadsword are propped up against one corner.  A sturdy door leads outside.

8114.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The top of the tower looks like it has been sheared off at an angle, leaving this area vulnerable to the often harsh climate.  A narrow, curving stairway hugs the wall, leading to the floor below.  Part of a large, oaken beam juts out from a small pile of rubble nearby.
title: [Luinne Bheinn, Peel Tower]
8116.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: This part of the church is filled with heavy, wooden pews.  Hauling the pews up to this mountain settlement must have been a long and strenuous affair.  Red, amber and blue lights caress the top portion of the pews.  An oaken door leads outside.
title: [Luinne Bheinn, Church]
8117.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Bathed in warm colors, a wooden pulpit dominates this area.  Behind the pulpit is a hexagonal window inlaid with red, amber and blue crystal panes.  A large oak tablet hangs on the wall.
title: [Luinne Bheinn, Church]
8118.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A rock-walled furnace filled with red glowing embers stands a bit off center on the dirt floor.  Next to it are two large barrels filled with tepid water.  Gear in various shapes and forms hang on the wall or lie on the workbenches.  A much-abused axe rests on a large, steel anvil.  The air is heavy with acrid smoke.  A sooty door leads out.
title: [Luinne Bheinn, Smithy]
8119.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A long table surrounded by high-backed chairs dominates the hall.  Carvings decorate much of the wooden surfaces.  Studded targes and crossed weapons adorn the walls.  The weaponry looks well-used and in excellent shape.  A reinforced oaken door leads outside.
title: [Luinne Bheinn, Great Hall]
8120.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: This chamber is small, but comfortable.  A high, wood-paneled bed stands in one corner, its shape reminiscent of a seafaring captain's bunk.  A small writing desk stands against the other wall -- a few papers, an old quill pen and a few other odds and ends lying on it.  A tawny humpbacked puma fur hangs on the wall.
title: [Luinne Bheinn, Chief's Bedroom]
8121.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A long counter takes up most of the space against one wall.  Flickering candles make the low ceiling dark and sooty, but cast a warm, amber light throughout the room.  A few round tables are surrounded by sturdy chairs.  The intimate ambiance is only slightly detracted from by the thin layer of dust that covers some of the less used areas.  An old, red-painted door leads outside.
title: [Luinne Bheinn, Tavern]
8122.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Round tables and old chairs occupy most of the floor space.  The tables all have lit candles on them, many of the candles stuck onto wine bottles.  The wooden floor is worn and uneven, more a dirty-grey than the original brown.  On the walls hang weapons, a couple of brass-studded targes and several finely carved oak crests.
title: [Luinne Bheinn, Tavern]
8123.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Planked seating take up much of the space here.  Two holes have been cut out of the top of the planks, the surrounding area well-polished by long usage. title: [Luinne Bheinn, Outhouse]
