description: It is difficult to see any great distance through the dense foliage.  The deep layer of fallen leaves makes it impossible to see any resemblance of a trail.  The scent of oak rides on the gentle breeze.

A small pool of water has collected in a low spot of the forest.  Several oak leaves sail across the puddle, pushed by the rare draft that slips through the trees.  Tracks of raccoons and deer are scattered around the soft mud bordering the water.

A grey squirrel rustles up in a tree, dropping acorns on to the forest floor.  Velvet-textured moss covers the base of the oak trees' trunks and across the bare spots of the ground.  The calmness of the air is eerie, the moonlight filtering through the branches above.

A large tree fell here recently.  A few saplings have already taken hold in its place, fighting for the spot the mighty oak once occupied.  The layers of brown leaves on the ground crunch under your feet with every step.  The forest seems to stretch on endlessly in every direction.

The trees are all starting to look the same.  Each direction looks exactly alike, trees and more trees merging into a combination of drab, natural colors.  The old forest is made up completely of oak trees, their dominance choking out any other plant growth that attempts to develop.

The ground under the fallen leaves is rather uneven, caused by the thick roots of the oaks and occasional rocks that protrude through the forest floor.  Vines hang down from lofty branches, stealing what little light passes through the ceiling of oak leaves before it reaches the ground.

This deep into the expansive forest, there are no signs of civilization visible.  Majestic oak trees are staggered randomly, stretching as far as the eye can see in all directions.  Piles of leaves almost cover the jagged rocks that poke through from the ground underneath.

Finding the way through the woods is difficult.  There are very few landmarks to navigate by, the large oak trees blending together in an array of browns, reds and greens.  Chitters of squirrels echo through the forest, along with the crackling of branches as they scurry through the highest limbs.

The air near the ground is still despite the gentle breeze rattling the leaves on the highest of branches above.  The few clouds visible through the small openings in the leafy canopy are slowly reshaped by the wind's endless touch.  The hoot of an owl in the distance breaks the silence of the forest.

Heavy brambles and underbrush conceal the west end of the path.
title: [Upper Trollfang, A Shaded Path]
24365.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The forest opens into a wide, moon-lit glade, the mossy ground crisscrossed by shifting patterns of green formed by the network of branches and vines above.  The glade opens a bit wider to the south, and turns into a thick copse of oaks to the west.  The heavy undergrowth at the southwest part of the glade barely hides the outlines of a rough wooden building of some sort.
title: [Ranger Guild, Wooded Glade]
24396.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A cluster of ancient oaks forms a quiet glade, their heavy branches and foliage concealing anything above from view. A sturdy wooden pavilion opens to the south, half-covered by bushes and flowering vines, and a wide ladder leads up the gnarled trunk of the largest of the oaks.
title: [Ranger Guild, Oak Grove]
24397.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The sturdy platform is constructed between the branches of the great oak, bounded by heavy moss-covered railings and covered by a network of carved beams that blend with the tree's branches above to protect from the elements.  A narrow rope bridge, almost invisible in the network of hanging vines that wind around it, leads west into the branches of another tree.
title: [Ranger Guild, Treehouse]
24398.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: From this small platform, a large expanse of pristine forest can be seen on three sides.  The occasional deer prances across the leaf-covered forest floor, oblivious to the observers in the tree house.  The small glade to the east is mostly hidden by the great oak tree which is connected to this scenic rest spot by the narrow rope bridge.
title: [Ranger Guild, Platform]
24399.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The pavilion is open to the elements on the north and east sides, its arched entryways half-covered by flowering bushes and vines that grow into the interior, spreading across the rough panelled walls and winding around the heavy ceiling beams. title: [Ranger Guild, Pavilion]
24401.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The trunks of two living oaks make up the south corners of the irregularly shaped niche. 24402.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A high wooden fence, half-hidden by vines and underbrush, curves around the south side of the glade. title: [Ranger Guild, Clearing]
24408.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The massive trunk of the tree supports this half of the treehouse, forming a solid wooden wall on the western side. 24409.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

24411.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

24412.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

28627.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

28628.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

28629.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

28630.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: This plateau in the stairs is decorated with various Dhe'nar relics which provide a distraction to the vertigo-inspiring twist of stairs below them. title: [Obsidian Tower, Stairway]
28631.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A gentle, rain-scented breeze pouring in from the huge bay window ruffles your hair. Over the fireplace you notice a fine portrait of a dark elven empath and half-elven cleric kneeling over a slain body in a forest. In the center of the room is a huge, neatly made bed full of soft pillows.

28632.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

A carved oak bed sits in the corner, covered with a quilted spread and edged with faint runes of ancient Dhe'nar legend. title: [Otterex's Room]
28633.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

title: [Krynith's Room]
28634.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: This room is notably bare of furniture.  A bed, built high off the ground, has been pushed up against the south wall, opposite the old wooden bookcase to the north. 28635.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Five glaes statues stand in alcoves that have been carved into the walls. title: [Obsidian Tower, Stairway]
28636.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A thunderstorm rages disconcertingly close to this rooftop perch.  Peering through the battlements, the Sentoph mountains are visible, clouds obscuring the tops of their peaks. title: [Obsidian Tower, Rooftop]
28637.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Candles too numerous to count line the walls, filling the air with their heady and almost seductive scent. 28638.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

In the center of the room lies an oak-framed four poster bed with an enormous puma hide rug at the foot.  Sitting off to one side of the bed is a wooden box with a small sign above it. title: [Celtic's Room]
28639.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Silver-inlaid black marble encompasses the walls and floor of this large room, thousands of tiny sparkling diamonds imbedded in the ceiling resemble the deep night sky. A large marble fireplace dominates the far wall, the constantly burning fire providing light and warmth in this dark room.

28640.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

title: [Starsnuffer's Room, Reception]
28641.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Four large black candles burn blue in the corners of the room. In the center of the room stands a black canopied bed, its heavy black curtains obscuring what lies within.
title: [Starsnuffer's Room, Bedroom]
28642.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Thick down comforters of black velvet sit atop fine spidersilk sheets.  Deep satin pillows lie against the headboard, obscuring several of the silvery runes carved there.  Hanging from the top of the bed are exquisite silver stars, moons, and other heavenly bodies, winking in and out in the dim light. 28643.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

28645.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

28646.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

32666.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

32667.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

32669.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

21687.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Stone walls wrap around to form a solid enclosure to the courtyard, the ground smooth and paved with dark cobblestones. 21688.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The floor of the main entry is of dark flagstone, deeply polished, the walls are of white marble, veined with crimson. meta: mapname:Wehnimer's Landing - House Of The Rising Phoenix
title: [House Phoenix, Entry]
21741.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Within this serene courtyard, a variety of young trees and flowering bushes thrive along the flagstone path leading from the archway to the main building.  A small grove of cherry trees provides a shady retreat near some polished wooden benches placed along a grassy bank leading down to a small bubbling spring.  Nestled within the shade of the fruit trees sits a small cherrywood beehive.  A polished cherry dart board inlaid with a rising phoenix hangs from a willow tree.
title: [Phoenix Annex, Courtyard]
21742.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: This quiet, leafy bower seems remote from the courtyard below.  The gentle swaying of the tree in the breeze and the susurration of the leaves is relaxing.  Peering down through the willow branches you can spy the natural pool below.
title: [Phoenix Annex, Willow Tree]
21743.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The small spring is lined with a brilliant array of colorful stones.  Exotic plants, carefully arranged to provide privacy, grow in profusion along the bank. Air bubbles rush up from below, tickling the bare parts of your skin.  A small waterfall trickles musically down a jumble of rocks, and a small wooden fishing dock juts out from a sandy bank.
title: [Phoenix Annex, Natural Springs]
21744.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The natural springs surrounding this dock start off shallow, but quickly turn deep at its very center. Protected from the elements, a small fire burns, remnants of previous fish fries evident all around it.
title: [Phoenix Annex, Fishing Dock]
21745.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A fine mist eddies about your ankles as you enter this quiet niche.  Well-tended herbs and flowers grow in abundance around a pure-white marbled bench, tickling the senses with the scent of hyssop, rosemary, mint and jasmine.  The sound of trickling water draws your eyes to a small grotto cut into a wall of gray rock glistening with moisture.  The grotto shelters a statuette perched upon an ivory altar covered with a pristine sheen of water that drips from an over-hanging rock.
title: [Phoenix Annex, Hyssopp's Niche]
21746.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The elegant Grand Hall appears to have hosted many a merry celebration.  Candlelight from faceted ruby and crystal chandeliers casts a warm glow over a grand cherry banquet table and matching gilded chairs.  Mirror-clad arched alcoves on one wall hold small tables for private gatherings.  Marble pilasters with gilded capitals depicting rising phoenixes frame elaborately figured silk tapestries flanking the great white marble fireplace on the eastern wall.  At the west end of the room rests a small bar.
title: [House Phoenix, Grand Hall]
21747.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Here in the kitchens, a large oven warms the room and fills it with the scent of baking bread. The walls of the room are filled with shelves and cupboards stacked high with dried and preserved foods of all sorts.  Piles of fresh vegetables and slabs of finely marbled meats wait for the deft hand of the chef to prepare them.
title: [House Phoenix, Kitchens]
21748.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The library of the House is a largish room, with walls completely hidden by bookcases.  A wide selection of reading material can be seen from a cursory glance. One rather extensive section seems devoted to arms and armor and the many subjects dealing with the arts of war.  Locked glass-fronted cabinets hold rare tomes and fragile scrolls and even the odd clay tablet.  Scattered around the room are several chairs.
title: [House Phoenix, Library]
21749.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A series of paintings hung along the walls here celebrate the founding officers of the House.  Two doors, one painted red, the other gold, lead to guest bedrooms.  To the south is a brightly painted door and eastwards, a solid oak door bars entrance to the Planning Room.

title: [Phoenix Annex, Guest Room]
21775.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

title: [Phoenix, Krisenfest's Room]
21776.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: This spacious room is warmed by sunlight streaming in through a window facing east. The oak floor is covered by a luxurious snow-white puma fur rug that almost looks as inviting as the bed.  In one corner stands a small bookcase filled neatly with several leather-bound books with esoteric titles.  Occasionally, you hear a faint sound coming from underneath the bed.
title: [Phoenix Annex, Catrissa's Room]
21777.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The hardwood floor is brightly polished and a thick white tapestry adorns one wall.  A flowering vine grows in a ceramic urn next to the wall, lending a pleasant aroma to the air.
title: [Phoenix Annex, South Hall]
21778.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A faint trace of residual magic tingles your fingertips as you cross the threshold of this workshop. The walls are lined with shelves and cabinets which contain beakers, flasks, and decanters of multi-colored liquids that sparkle in the light.
title: [Phoenix Annex, Workshop]
21779.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The brightly polished oak floor reflects the light from a pair of simple silver sconces attached to the wall.  A sweet soprano voice quietly singing an old folk song flows from an archway set in the northern wall.
title: [House Phoenix, Donation Room]
21780.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: One wall of this small, well-lit hallway is decorated with a pair of magnificent paintings.  The other is almost completely covered with a grand tapestry depicting a battle scene.  In the flickering torchlight the figures on the tapestry seem to come to life.
title: [Phoenix Annex, Temple Hallway]
21781.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: This tranquil room has been consecrated and dedicated to prayer, contemplation and reflection.  Four rows of pews with kneelers give the room a sense of order and discipline.  Inscriptions, inlaid with silver, grace three of the walls.
title: [Phoenix Annex, Sanctuary]
21782.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Wisps of green, yellow and orange smoke drift lazily about the pavilion, all eventually rising to seep through a small opening in the top of the tent.  Two grey canvas walls are nearly concealed by thick wooden shelves, each one sporting a variety of colorful bottles and smoking vials.  In a corner of the tent sits a twitchy-eyed halfling alchemist, coughing and wheezing as he mixes the contents of glowing beakers.
title: [Consumption Junction]
21903.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Floral patterns in rose and cream velvet frame the windows of this delightfully private chamber.  Enclosed with a canopy and curtains of sheer lace, a large bed rests opposite a fireplace which burns with a cheerful light.  In front of the fireplace, there is a soft fur rug.  A delicately carved oak sideboard stands alongside the gold door.
title: [Silvergate, Bridal Suite]
22014.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The warm humid air of this tropical retreat invites you to cast away your worries and cares.  Flowering vines creep up the carved posts of a four-poster bed which provides support for a canopy of rustling ferns.  Water trickles from a fountain, cunningly crafted to resemble a waterfall, and fills a small bathing pool near the fireplace.  Several colorful cushions are scattered on the floor near the hearth.
title: [Silvergate, Jungle Room]
22027.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The warm soothing water relaxes your muscles and the scents of rose and cedar intermingle in the air, leaving you with a renewed spirit.  How refreshing!  Fresh water constantly trickles in from the mouth of a small marble fish statue.
title: [Jungle Room, Bathing Pool]
22028.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Fresh as a country meadow, this cozy room welcomes you.  Pale green linens cover a brass bed, their color echoed in simple cotton curtains patterned with meadow flowers.  Painted carvings of herbs decorate the cream colored walls.  An armoire, crafted of rare varin stands in one corner, complementing the antique nightstands at bedside.  Opposite the bed, two cushioned chairs flank a brick fireplace.  A pot of fresh herbs, simmering over a small fire, fills the air with a fresh scent.
title: [Silvergate, Country Retreat]
22029.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Three curving walls of this chamber have been painted with fanciful scenes of merfolk and nymphs sporting among ocean waves and sunswept beaches.  A brilliant sunset depicted on the west wall cleverly frames an arched fireplace.  Midnight blue silk panels, embroidered with tiny silver stars and draped from the ceiling above, sway gently in a warm updraft, creating the illusion of a twinkling night sky.  Centered in the room, a feather bed hangs suspended from the ceiling on cotton ropes.
title: [Silvergate, Ocean Room]
22030.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Smelling the fragrance of fresh cedar, you glance up and notice that the ceiling of this simply furnished room has been paneled with the reddish wood.  A simple arrangement of flowering blossoms is displayed in a niche centered in one of the cream colored walls.  The window opposite the door is covered by a delicate carved screen, through which you hear the sound of chimes blowing in the wind.  Thick straw matting covers most of the floor, rising several inches above the entry to this room.
title: [Silvergate, Dragon Room]
22031.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Stacked casks of mead and ale take up most of the space in this huge room dedicated to storage. A half-windowed door to the south gives a picturesque view of the livestock pens of the Inner Bailey.
title: [Helden Hall, Buttery]

The crystals are connected to each other by strands of pure energy that seem to emanate somehow from an underground stream that flows through here.  Carved into one stone wall is a stone counter, and a few stone bar stools cluster around it.

description: Burnished wooden planks curve out to form the massive hall of the tavern's entrance, with rows of sturdy oaken posts rising to connect with a network of rafters above.  Dozens of blackened oil lanterns hang from the ceiling, their light at times a haze behind wisps of smoke drifting in from the galley.  In the center rests a huge cast-iron pot surrounded by countless tables and barrel chairs.  A half-circle driftwood bar is nestled in the corner beneath a salt-stained crest.
title: [Rusty Cutlass, Grub Hall]

description: Faint light from the main deck above seeps in through tiny grates in the ceiling, just enough to illuminate part of the compartment's ballast in the form of piles of huge sandbags, wooden crates, and iron-banded barrels.  The rest of the hold is aglow from the fire of hanging lanterns which help to display a coral-ringed dart board hung firmly on a wall.  A large cloth hammock is pulled tight between two oaken posts in the far corner of the room.
title: [Rusty Cutlass, The Hold]
30277.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The back of the galley is dominated by an enormous red brick oven, its center set with a long oily grate above a glowing fire.  A high shelf almost droops beneath the weight of bags of flour, iron pots and pans, and nearly a hundred corked bottles of rum.  A wide worktable is suspended from the ceiling by heavy ropes and its surface is scattered with various meat cleavers, jars of spices, and old stains.  Several crates and iron-banded barrels occupy every corner of the kitchen.
title: [Rusty Cutlass, The Galley]
30278.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The main deck of the tavern looks to be untouched by the elements, but its wooden plank flooring is marred by countless scuff marks.  Guests linger and speak in hushed tones along the wooden railings, while the murmur of voices carries down from the quarterdeck above.  A thick rope ladder hangs on the side of the huge wooden mainmast as lights flicker in the breeze from several tiny lanterns dangling from the ship's netting above.  Two wide wooden stairs frame a tall iron-bound door.
title: [Rusty Cutlass, Main Deck]
30279.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The surface of the forecastle rests in the shadow of the topsail and its wooden planks are a stark contrast to the main deck below.  Old stains from a mixture of blood, ale, and fish guts have discolored the flooring along every board near the railings.  A few wooden barrels sit in the center of the main railing, each one crowded with some tackle boxes, lures and tiny metal hooks.  Some carved wooden benches rest on each side of the sculpted bronze figurehead that faces out towards Darkstone Bay.
title: [Rusty Cutlass, Forecastle]
30280.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A pile of weathered and faded pillows provides a measure of comfort near a wide wooden railing that looks out over Darkstone Bay.  The salty spray of the waters periodically splashes up to add to the stains along a copper-banded keg, while a narrow wooden gangplank juts out over the side of the deck, warped under the weight of time and use.
title: [Rusty Cutlass, Gangplank]
30281.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The top of the main mast reaches its peak at the crow's nest, which has been crafted to resemble a huge wooden barrel held together by bands of sturdy iron.  From this vantage point more than half of Wehnimer's Landing can be seen, as well as far out onto the waters of Darkstone Bay.

description: A soft breeze rustles the wide expanse of grass scattered with tiny wildflowers and enclosed by an ivy-covered stone wall. Wrought iron tables and benches are spaced around a brick firepit amid clusters of tall evergreen trees, which provide pockets of shade.  Silvery lions mounted on the wall hold cut crystal oil lamps.  North of the path, bursts of color can be spied through the windows of a small copper-framed greenhouse.

description: The room is lit by several brass lanterns that sway in time to the gentle rocking of the ship.  Cloyingly sweet cigar smoke hangs in the air, drifting in from a carved maoral arch that leads into a shady-looking casino.  A brass rod suspending a heavy black curtain with muffled sounds coming from behind it -- clearly inaccessible to the public -- is positioned near a long modwir bar at the back of the room.  A heavy scarlet curtain is draped over one of the walls, providing a dark wash of sanguine color to the bar.
title: [Furrfoot's Revenge, Barroom]

description: A portrait of a scowling dwarf is hung above the long modwir bar flanked by two brass lanterns.  The bar itself gleams from a fresh polishing as evidenced by the damp cleaning rag left lying on top of it.  The multitude of liquor bottles and tapped kegs behind the bar are expertly secured for sea by sailors who obviously take their drinking seriously.  A ragged mop lies propped up by the exit to the main barroom.  At one end of the bar, an open doorway is shrouded in shadows and a smoky haze.
title: [The Grumpy Ole Dwarf Bar]

description: Shielded by verdant hedges, the spire's reflection garden adds a grace note of natural beauty to the building's austere architecture.  A circular pool surrounded by smooth white benches provides a serene focal point for the setting, while artfully shaped topiaries create a private reserve of fanciful beasts along the tranquil garden's periphery.  Flowering vines around a central statue add a note of welcome color.
title: [Faendryl Enclave, Garden]

description: The surrounding rubble is damp, with little pools of water scattered between and atop various boulders and clusters of rocks, as well as a spattering of dead fish.  Trickles of black water cascade down from above, sourced from the almost invisible flow of a water snaking into a volomnious black void overhead.  Abutting where the water above ostensibly falls in heavy sheets when the void is not present, the wall has eroded away, leaving an opening where the rock has fallen in on itself and now provides egress.

Pounding down from above, a rapidly rushing waterfall falls in heavy sheets, creating a shin-deep turbulent pool of water, large boulders and clusters of rock jutting from below the surface.  Before continuing on its way downstream in a miniature flood, the inky black water fades in color and visual texture to the normalized murk of the Locksmehr River.
title: [Underground Tunnels, Rubble]

description: Redolent with mold, moist air wafts in from above the catacombs.  Three of the walls are each inset with thirty-six shelf graves, stacked in series of six and filled with small, splintered bones rife with gnaw marks.  The eastern wall instead has only ten intact graves, the others clearly lost to an eroded wall opening.  Copious patches of luminous moss creep over the walls, the greenish light lending an eerie aura to the tomb.  To one side of the chamber, a wide space is centered with several burial pits.
title: [Ruined Catacombs]
24975.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Clearly in a state of distintegration, the catacomb's northern bank of tombs has completely crumpled, a veritable cave-in having crushed any skeletal remains.  Filling the other walls are sets of thirty-six shelf tombs, save for the western wall, which instead only has seventeen.  A collection of urns, some intact but most nothing more than broken shards, lie in a jumbled pile beneath the watchful eyes of a statue with the body of a mutilated human and the distorted head of a serpent.  Tinged with the odor of mold and decay, the air here is cold and dry, yet somehow also stuffy.
title: [Ruined Catacombs]
